entries.cad3d3e94ea3d524: As its corporate philosophy, the company sets out “Opening the Future with Sensibility and Technology,” aiming to create new “value” through superior sensibility and technology and to achieve stable, sustainable growth by expanding its business domains and exports. In its medium- to long-term management strategy, the company's basic policy is to establish a stable earnings base in its existing businesses, and it states that it will build a stable earnings base in the dyeing and finishing business and strengthen in-house sales through collaboration between the dyeing and finishing business and the product sales business.
